test_included.testName: When is the Dengue Profile (Rapid) with CBC  Test recommended?
test_included.description: It is recommended: In case there is a high fever within 2 weeks of travelling to an area where a dengue outbreak has occurred or the dengue fever is endemic. The initial symptoms that are commonly seen include sudden high fever and flu-like symptoms that appear about 4 to 7 days after being infected by a dengue mosquito. Other signs and symptoms include severe headaches, especially behind the eyes, joint and muscle pain, nausea, vomiting, skin rash, and swollen glands.

The Dengue Profile (Rapid) with CBC  Test measures: The dengue virus or antibodies. Dengue fever is a viral infection that is transmitted to humans by mosquitoes that live in tropical regions and subtropical climates and are responsible for carrying the virus.
